summary: OpenCode is offering the Ox Alpha stealth model free for one week: 1M-token context, multi-modal input, zero data retention, and generous rate limits the team describes as near unlimited usage, backed by a claimed 100T tokens/day capacity. Announced by the official OpenCode account on August 20, 2026.

Select Ox Alpha (Free) and start a coding task.
